The <b>Conjoined Heart</b> is a [[Items_(Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable item]] and [[Materium#Mementos|memento]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==

The Conjoined Heart may be used along with the [[Pollen Heart]], the [[Hunter's Heart]], and/or the [[Encrusted Heart]] to complete the <i>[[SEEK: The Old Hearts]]</i> [[Objectives|objective]].

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Red Memory.png!Snail Shamans location in Moss Grotto
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Snail Shamans 01.png!Snail Shamans in the Ruined Chapel in Moss Grotto
}}

If the Conjoined Heart is obtained afterwards, as a fourth heart, or if all 4 hearts are collected before completing <i>[[SEEK: The Old Hearts]]</i>, then it becomes a [[memento]] that can be displayed on a shelf in the [[Bellhome]]. After interacting with the desk, it appears in the top-middle slot of the shelving.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Bellhome.png!Location in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Bellhart 09.png!Displayed inside Bellhome in Bellhart
}}

== How to Acquire ==
The Conjoined Heart is acquired after defeating the [[Clover Dancers]] in [[Lost Verdania]].
